desc:
Welcome to Aqua Animation Roleplay!!! Here you can Roleplay as aqua animation characters to make your own story!! 
There are over 50+ Animations that you can use in your story! Music, and faces to roleplay with! Along with different maps!

Rework Update:
- Reworked 10+ Old animations
- Added new feature to Character Selector
- New Animations
- New Music
- Bug Fixes

(No asking for admin. Can be banned or kicked for asking.)

If The Game Gets shut down then that means there is a update happening! 

Private Servers (DO COME WITH ADMIN COMMANDS!)
But only for the owner of the private server!

Credit to Doge/Gravydude for throw animation idea! All credit goes to Aqua Animation for characters and faces! Also credit to Ryker for some of the Aqua Animation Faces!
